input: 161 chromosome 21 and MT records (148 on 21, 13 on MT), the union of two record sets selected over the native cache: the attribute set (SNVs, deletions, insertions and MNVs from the GRCh38 golden corpus's chromosome 21 records plus records placed on a Mt_tRNA, the MT-ND1 CDS (codon table 2), an intron of a cds_start_NF transcript, an exon of a readthrough transcript, the MIR548X miRNA, the Y_RNA gene named by RFAM, the CYP4F29P gene named by EntrezGene, the TMPRSS15 and CHODL coding sequences and a lncRNA without a symbol) and the frame set (coding, splice-region, UTR, start and stop positions of every protein-coding transcript of the 21:34000001-35000000, 42000001-43000000 and 45000001-47000000 windows and of every MT gene, where the exon phases, the N-padded translateable sequence, the UTRs and the codon table decide the consequence, codon and protein columns); the reference base is the GRCh38 primary assembly's

json_cache.source: built by vep-cache-builder from the release 116 GRCh38 GFF3 (the chromosome 21 and MT lines), the peptide FASTA, the chromosome 21 and MT genome FASTA and the core and variation MySQL table dumps (--core-dumps), then pruned to the records' transcripts with scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip (no key dropped)
json_cache.info_json: derived from the Ensembl VEP cache's info.txt as every corpus's is, so the version header the format tests compare matches; the native build's own info.json carries the assembly, gencode and genebuild versions alone

generator: vep-cache-builder --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --gff3 <chr21+MT lines of Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.116.gff3.gz> --fasta Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.pep.all.fa.gz --core-dumps <dir> --genome-fasta <chr21+MT .fa> --output-dir <cache>; scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --suite <id>=<reference>=<designed and chr21 records> --suite <id>=<reference>=<frame records> --k 1 --seed 1 --cache <cache> --family-columns SYMBOL=,SYMBOL_SOURCE=,HGNC_ID,TSL,MANE_SELECT,CANONICAL,FLAGS=,ENSP,BIOTYPE= --covers ... --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=--symbol ... --out tests/golden/116/GRCh38-native-builder; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --cache <cache> --out <corpus>/json_cache --vcf <corpus>/variants.vcf --gzip; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --info-only --perl-info <perl cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus <corpus> --perl-cache-dir <dir>; scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py flag-set and classify (the manifest's run and the ccds, gencode_basic, gencode_primary and flag_gencode_primary sets; each set's expected outputs are Ensembl VEP's four formats on its own cache for the same records under the set's flags)
